note: Both arms are exactly deterministic, so this band is not absorbing run-to-run noise; there is none. It is safe to make it this tight because the metrics are exact rationals once rank order is fixed, and rank order is not marginal: the smallest relative score gap between adjacent ranks in any query's top 6 is 1.5e-3, twelve orders of magnitude above float64 noise, so no platform reorders these results. The width is set just under the smallest behavioural move actually observed while mutation-testing the arms (0.0093 of MRR, from a BM25 minimum-token-length change that shifts one query from rank 2 to rank 3). Anything that changes retrieval behaviour at all should land outside this band and be re-recorded deliberately.
